thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for customer 'Hawthorne Labs' on dedicated cluster dh-west2-07. 10m 5xx rate = 18%, p95 latency = 1.3s, errors are primarily 502/504. Paging pgp-oncall.

maria (oncall): I'm on it. Looking at dashboards now. Any reproducible request path?

leo (support): Customer support just reported timeouts from their ingestion pipeline ~10:12 UTC. They see ~15% of requests failing with 502.

jamal (sre): I'm seeing queue depth spike on the serving gateway in dh-west2-07. KV cache evictions increased, per-GPU inflight > 95%. Suspect noisy tenant or small bursty workload causing head-of-line.

sophia (runtime): Adding logs — from proxy: ```level=error ts=2026-03-12T10:11:32Z component=gateway msg="upstream response error" status=502 host=hawthorne-prod model=redwood-open-7b route=/generate```. Also see repeated connection resets to backend pods.

maria (oncall): Good. First mitigation: enable rapid throttling for hawthorne-prod route and bump routing weight to fallback pool. Can someone push a policy?

jamal (sre): Pushing temporary rate-limit rule now (ID: rl-4790). Command: ```rctl set-rate hawthorne-prod 20rps --scope=tenant --duration=10m``` -> applied.

ops-bot: Rate limit rl-4790 applied to hawthorne-prod (20rps) by jamal.

sophia (runtime): Also kicking an autoscale action to add 2 nodes to the dedicated pool: ```infra scale dh-west2-07 --add 2```. ETA ~ 90s for new GPUs.

leo (support): Notifying customer: "We've applied traffic shaping and are scaling capacity; you may see reduced errors in the next few minutes."

maria (oncall): Checking inflight queue after rate-limit: inflight dropped from 420 -> 120 in ~40s. 5xx rate trending down to 7% (10m window).

jamal (sre): Watching KV evictions: rate decreasing, cache hitrate improving. Autoscale spawn confirmed, new nodes joining the pool.

incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: rate-limit applied, autoscale requested, customer notified.

sophia (runtime): After scaling + throttling, p95 latency down to 480ms, 5xx steady at ~2% over last 5m. I want to mark this as partial mitigation. Need to find root cause — probable noisy tenant or a model variant with pathologically long decode times.

maria (oncall): Who owns traffic shaping cleanup? We should schedule rollback of rl-4790 once steady. I'll leave rl-4790 active and check again in 15m.

jamal (sre): I'll correlate tenant usage and model kv pressure. Query I'm running: ```SELECT tenant, qps, avg_decode_ms FROM telemetry WHERE cluster='dh-west2-07' AND ts > now()-15m ORDER BY qps DESC LIMIT 20;```

leo (support): Customer says they have a backlog re-ingesting missed events. They accepted the temporary shaping but asked for ETA on full recovery. I told them ~20m.

maria (oncall): Update: 5xx < 1% last 2m, gateway timeouts resolved. Marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep an eye and escalate to postmortem if root cause isn't clear.

sophia (runtime): Filing follow-up task: investigate tenant-hotspotting, autoscale policy revisions (lower spin-up time or enable warm standby), and add metric for per-tenant inflight ratio.

maria (oncall): Preliminary impact: ~1.2k requests failed for Hawthorne over 12 minutes, customer-visible errors peaked at 15%. No data loss reported.

jamal (sre): Next steps: dig into model traces for any long-running batches, check whether sandboxed jobs or experiments were scheduled on same pool. I'll own RCA.

leo (support): I'll prepare a customer incident note to send after RFC for public-facing language.

maria (oncall): Thanks all. Standown in 10m unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark: 

ops-bot: Incident annotated as "mitigated" by maria. Follow-up tickets created: RDW-5121 (RCA), RDW-5122 (autoscale warm standby), RDW-5123 (per-tenant inflight alert).
